name: mace
description: 👥 A clerk's bench for meetings run under Robert's Rules — where the registered WebMCP tool set IS the motion stack. An action that is out of order does not exist to be called.

paragraphs: One integer. Seventeen tools become nine, and the phase never moves (§40). Seven leave by aborting the AbortSignal they were registered with; one leaves by dropping a toolname attribute.
The bench at “the tangle”. Everything on the right is rendered from document.modelContext.getTools() — the API's own return value.

An agent, not us. ChatGPT executes setmemberspresent and the page crosses quorum — the state changed, so this cannot be a model reading the screen. Note the banner: that client's modelContext is not an EventTarget, and mace says so rather than pretending.
features: Look at the right-hand panel. movetoamendtheamendment is gone — a first-degree
Ask your agent "what can I do right now?" It reads the same list the panel does.
